facts.fact: The Namibian reports that the Minister of Information and Communication Technology 'officially launched' the National Digital Strategy (NDS) on Tuesday (5 August 2025, the day before the 6 August report); no Cabinet or other adopting act is named. The NDS is described as a framework for Namibia's holistic digital advancement supporting socio-economic and environmental development, which the minister addressed to youth, entrepreneurs, educators, health workers, farmers and labourers.
